essence: Bliss is neither wealth-intoxication nor lamp-sun-moon splendour. Joy dawns when difference is gathered away, the burden set down, and the lost treasure of non-duality recalled — that is the light's arising. Bliss = prakāśodaya: difference gathered, burden set down, treasure remembered.

rasa.sthayibhava: ānanda (bliss) as the forgotten treasure found
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of finding (prāpti); the vyabhicāri is joy (harṣa) of burden-lowering. The rasa is bliss as ingress into fullness, not as pleasure or splendour — the forgotten treasure remembered.
